name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-taskqueue
description: Client-level task queue: dump non-urgent ideas, auto-execute during off-peak (cheap) windows, at set times, or right after a container restart (--on restart / -r / when="restart" (v0.6.1 adds the single-dash -r alias for iOS), detected via PID1 starttime change, one attempt per restart); v0.4.0 adds /queue RPC channel (list/edit/cancel/runnow) for the editable queue panel in dsh-notice-banner; v0.5.0 adds queued-sending state (dispatched but still waiting in target session inbox) that remains cancelable — cancel withdraws the queued message via Inbox.remove; v0.7.0 adds off-peak travel mode (错峰出行模式): when enabled in settings, all messages sent during peak hours are auto-queued via /queue RPC add instead of reaching the LLM — client bundle intercepts session.prompt; v0.8.0 adds per-session bypass (单会话豁免, mode.exempt RPC + exempt map in offpeak-mode.json, toggle in the input-row pill next to the Full access select) and moves the notice from the floating dock above the input into the composer row with a matching input-card border tint (:has() CSS) — local helper plugin, not an official package; v0.8.4 (2026-09-12) restores the blank-session engage turn (新会话转正, anti session-mixing) that silently died in 0.1.2 because session.events no longer exists (blank was always false) — readSessionEvents()/isBlankSession() now read snapshotEvents()/ownEvents() and all 5 former session.events call sites are adapted; RPC add returns engaged for diagnostics; v0.8.3 (2026-09-12) fixes the 0.1.2 session-scope slot contract (conversation.input.left passes sessionId/useSession instead of session, which silently removed the pill AND left the prompt interceptor uninstalled) and adds a debug forced-window override (mode.debug: peak/offpeak/auto, server+client share one peak verdict) plus client diagnostics reporting (/queue diag -> log/taskqueue/offpeak-debug.log) with window.__dshTaskqueueDebug; v0.8.2 (2026-09-02) collapses the input-row status pill into a small icon on mobile (viewport ≤640px, like the Full access control) and opens a click popover with the full status text, a short explanation and the per-session bypass (本会话立即发送) switch — the switch now lives inside the popover at every width, replacing the v0.8.1 word-only short labels and the v0.8.0 inline pill switch
